Confirmed: `98322172` is an ancestor of the fix commit, and its diff directly introduces the problematic skip-logic that `7a91a35` later corrects.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 98322172593acecf02869258c392cc4d08155fb1

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the history of `src/main/java/maud/Util.java` with `git log -p --follow`, specifically searching for prior occurrences of the `sourceTrack != null` check and the `retargetTrack` signature that appear in the fix diff. This surfaced two relevant commits: `fe2ccb8` (immediately preceding `7a91a35`) and `9832217` (which first introduced the pattern being fixed).

**(2) The introducing change:** Commit `9832217` refactored `retargetAnimation`/`retargetTrack`. Before it, `retargetTrack` looked up the source track internally via `MyAnimation.findTrack(...)` and called `sourceTrack.getTimes()` unconditionally — so a bone with no source animation track would throw an NPE. `9832217` "fixed" that NPE by moving the `findTrack` lookup to the caller and wrapping the call in `if (sourceTrack != null) { ... result.addTrack(track); }`, i.e., when a target bone has no corresponding animated source track, it is silently skipped — **no track is added for that bone at all** — rather than giving it a sensible default (bind-pose) track. `fe2ccb8` only added an explanatory comment (`// handle null sourceTrack`) to this same code without changing behavior, confirming the logic (and the underlying bug) originated in `9832217`.

**(3) Evidence:** `7a91a35`'s fix removes exactly the `if (sourceTrack != null)` guard added in `9832217`, and instead makes `retargetTrack` itself handle a `null` sourceTrack by synthesizing a single bind-pose keyframe (`numKeyframes = 1; times[0] = 0f`) so every mapped target bone always receives a track. This is the direct functional inverse of what `9832217` introduced, and `9832217` is confirmed (via `git merge-base --is-ancestor`) to be an ancestor of `7a91a35` on this branch. I'm confident `9832217` is the bug-introducing commit; `fe2ccb8` is not a candidate since it made no logic change.
